gate_definition: Gate number = test MRR of the faithful run (released code + released configuration) scored with the official py-tgb 2.3.0 Evaluator on the shipped test negatives. EdgeReMIND: the authors' own evaluate_parallel number (same formula as Evaluator) and the per-query Evaluator.eval re-score with the authors' cutoffs must agree; CountTRuCoLa: official Evaluator over its rankings (ties averaged); the authors' own EVAL_TYPE=random number is reported alongside, not used for the gate.
history_boundary_for_dumps: EXT_alone requires the HRcov history boundary (facts with t' < t). EdgeReMIND's released evaluation uses position cutoffs over 200-event batches (earlier same-timestamp batches visible). The dumps therefore re-score every query with the trained (unchanged) theta and the strict cutoff t' < t; the faithful-cutoff per-query numbers are recorded alongside for documentation. Training is not changed.
countTRuCoLa_config_caveat: The released config-default.yaml DATASET_OVERRIDES for tkgl-smallpedia do not set C_X_COUNT; main.py then sets C_X_COUNT=20 when large_data_flag (> 1M quads incl. inverses) whereas paper Table 6 lists Cx-count=3. The gate run uses the released config unchanged; the effective options are recorded from the run log. No re-run with other values is used for the gate; if the gate fails, at most one diagnostic run with the Table 6 values may be reported, labelled 'paper-table-6 config (diagnostic, not the gate)'.
resources: CPU only on <HOST>, 16 workers per method, host MemAvailable guard 80 GB (process tree killed below it); polecat runs only if the measured requirement fits without that guard tripping and <= 24 h wall per seed.
dump_format: per split: top_ids [Q,1000] int32, top_scores [Q,1000], floor [Q], tail_min [Q], n_gt_floor [Q], gold [Q], gold_score [Q], rr_official [Q], rank_official [Q], keys_harness [Q,4] (s, r, o, ts_id); harness split_queries order; ties broken by entity id ascending
